senses.gloss:
वे वे, i. 1, Par. Ātm. To weave, MBh. 1, 806.
 --With the prep. आ आ, To warp, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 7.
 --With प्र प्र, To work in the woof, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 7 (‘Who is the warp and the weft of the universe’).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. प्रोत, i. e. प्र-उत.
 1. Sewn or stitched.
 2. Joined.
 3. Tied, strung.
 4. Set, inlaid.
 5. Pierced, Ragh. 9, 75.
 6. Put on (a spit), MBh. 1, 4316; impaled. n. Cloth.
 --Cf. ἤτριον, ὀθόνη; O.H.G. wât; A.S. waed, vestimentum; O.H.G. weban; A.S. wefan (= the regular Sskr. Caus., which would have been वापय or व्ăपय), waefels, weft; probably also ὀπέας, ἠπητής; akin at least is also ὑϕή, ὑϕαίνω; Lat. viere, vimen.
